units.source_text: “再努一把力，也许会好些，不料我已经衰弱不堪。

en.t: If I made one more effort, perhaps things would improve, but unexpectedly I am already utterly weakened.

units.source_text: 倘使只有两三千元又另当别论，可这是十二三万元啊。

en.t: If it were only two or three thousand yuan, that would be another matter, but this is a hundred twenty or thirty thousand yuan.

units.source_text: 啊，拜托你办件事，也许是办不到了。

en.t: Ah, there is something I want to ask you to do, though perhaps it can no longer be done.

units.source_text: 我不能去，是不是请大隈先生来一趟呢。

en.t: I cannot go, so could we ask Mr. Okuma to come here once?
Do not make a fool of me.

units.source_text: 就是做不了的事，我也要做出来。

en.t: Even if it is something impossible, I will still make it happen.

units.source_text: 喏，美代，要是做不了，这个拥有七百年历史的家业也就完了。”

en.t: Look, Miyo, if I cannot do it, this family business with seven hundred years of history will be finished.
